description: The daily history of one public profile we have already archived: how its follower count moved, day by day. ⚠️ It only covers what was captured after somebody first asked for that profile — the series starts the day of the first call and never earlier, and the response says so in `covered_from`. A handle nobody ever asked for comes back with an empty series, which means 'we never looked', never 'nothing changed'. Requires an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` — free key at https://honesthook.com/docs#key; costs 1 credit — free when nothing is found.

from.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601. Optional. Anything else answers 400.

handle.description: The account handle, without the leading @. On Mastodon it must be `user@instance`, because the same local name exists on many servers.

limit.description: How many days to return. Optional.

platform.description: Which platform the archived profile is on.

to.description: End of the window, ISO 8601. Optional.

name: profile_history
title: Daily history of a profile
